records.scientific_name: Allium sativum L. — aged garlic extract
preparation: aged aqueous/ethanolic garlic extract; commercial preparations vary

chemistry.role: water-soluble sulfur compound commonly used as AGE marker
organosulfur compound reported in aged garlic

human_research.finding: 2026 systematic review/meta-analysis of 10 randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trials (n=625) found small, non-significant pooled changes in systolic/diastolic blood pressure.
Same 2026 analysis reported a significant pooled reduction in TNF-alpha, with heterogeneity across outcomes.
Triglycerides and cholesterol-related outcomes showed variable effects; do not equate biomarker changes with event prevention.

safety.hazard: do not generalize evidence from aged garlic extract to raw garlic or garlic essential oil

human_research.finding: 2024 systematic review/meta-analysis of six randomized trials (n=528) found increased risks of headache, nausea, anxiety, dizziness and elevated blood pressure at therapeutic doses; effects generally resolved within 48 hours.
2025 meta-analysis identified 9 RCTs / 602 participants; reporting quality and risk of bias varied substantially.

safety.hazard: rare serious adverse events in clinical literature
safety.note: Controlled clinical populations differ from unsupervised use.

human_research.finding: 2026 systematic review included 12 clinical trials / 174 participants; rapid onset and short duration were characteristic; no serious adverse events were reported in those controlled studies.
Controlled human studies report rapid, intense alterations in perception, cognition and self-experience.

safety.note: Risk is contextual and may be undercounted in controlled studies.

provenance_rule: Every substantive claim should point to one or more sources and one evidence level. Community and traditional sources remain queryable but are never silently promoted to clinical evidence.
safety_rule: Safety information is a first-class data type. Interaction warnings should be linked to agents, mechanisms, evidence level, and uncertainty rather than presented as generic disclaimers.
